description: Repair the canonical scanner's repeatable out-of-memory failure on the Reading Advantage monorepo while preserving deterministic graph semantics, atomic publication, and installed-artifact truth.
deviation_notes: The indexed-only candidate missed the formal gate at 2,313,020 KiB and 900 seconds, so the activated fallback implemented deepest-tsconfig ownership, 32-file syntax-only batches, AST-free global resolution, and atomic path-based persistence. Independent review initially failed closeout on aggregate-only diagnostics, a default-timeout persistence test, stale verification, and audit disposition. Remediation added stage diagnostics, explicit integration timeouts, bounded syntax-only audit parsing, disambiguated-name correctness, and durable H/I/J evidence. The exact release candidate completed in 6:05 at 1,613,340 KiB peak RSS, a 50.7% reduction, and was atomically installed with matching checksum and rollback copy.
